title: Neher De Passey Ro Ro
body:
Teray Alman Valay Nay Nahi Ouna, Oh Sam Gaya Ay Katwa Kay Apniyan Bahwaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Rab Janda Ay Kiwain Ujar Gaiyan Nay Karbal Vich Raat Guzari
Rehyan Behna Toldiyan Veeran Nu Haye Maqtal Chon
Putran Nu Labhdiyan Mawan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Fizza Nu Cha Shimar Kaminay Aina Paigham Sunaya
Sab Bibiyan Burqayan Nu La La Kay Khud Dain Gaiyan
Ya Main Khaimay Vich Awaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hun A Vi Ja Ay Fazal Da Baba Mushkil Zainab Tay Bun Gaye
Ay Akhri Khaima Vi Saar Dita Haye Shaamiyan Nay
Kiwain Putar Sajjad Bachawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Vich Pathran De Tak Lash Veeran Di Dukhi Zainab Ri Farmaya
Dus Veer Namazi Ay Ujri Nu Teino Dafan Karan
Ya Shaam De Pasay Jawan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Lehranda Ay Jadon Alaam Ghazi Da Away Chaita Karbobala Da
Akhtar Har Momin Di Akhiyan Chon Athru Vagday
Yaad Aondyan Pak Wafan.
